Overview

A micron pen drawing based on a photo I took while working at The Bourne Mansion in Oakdale, NY. It reveals a view out of a curtain-draped window in the Library room facing The Great South Bay, showing the outdoor brick patio with St. Joseph's Hall in the background of the former Le Salle Military Academy.

Process / Additional Notes

Micron pen drawing on Vellum Bristol Board based on a reference photo I took while working at The Bourne Mansion.
